Review notes (not customer-facing)

This is a concept file on your computer. Nothing here is published, and the live store is unchanged. Products, prices and stock counts were read from your store when the file was built.

Samurai Sword TokyoStrong: live stock counts, quick-order list, daily gacha and points. Weak: dense tables, banner carousel. Here: stock counts on every card, one-screen shop, and a pack-rip reveal for the welcome offer instead of a banner.
Dave & Adam'sStrong: free shipping threshold, rewards, buy list. Here: the $150 threshold is a live progress bar in the cart.
Steel CityStrong: clear presell terms and loyalty tiers. Here: drop radar with countdowns and a release timeline. No loyalty program yet.
Blowout CardsStrong: case pricing for breakers. Here: a dedicated case vault with pack-out counts.
PokeVaultStrong: 25+ years of trust and customer reviews. Weak: dated catalog layout. Here: the TCGplayer rating is in the hero. On-site reviews would still help.
Plaza JapanStrong: light/dark mode, multi-currency. Here: light/dark toggle. No multi-currency.

Pokémon Center, TCGplayer and DA Card World pages couldn't be loaded for a direct look, so those rows rely on a third-party guide or are left out.
